verses.1: Prayer for Moses, the man of God. Adonai, you have been our refuge in times of need. You have always been with us.
verses.2: Before the mountains were born, and the earth and sea existed, you were there. You are eternal.
verses.3: Let man remain until then, and then it will be said, “Return, children of Adam.”
verses.4: For even though a thousand years seem like nothing in your eyes, they will still pass by. And their memory will be forgotten during the night.
verses.5: Your waters will flow again in the morning, like a stream that keeps flowing continuously.
verses.6: In the morning, it rises and moves towards evening. It becomes dark and quiet.
verses.7: For all of us are in your hands and under your control; we tremble with fear.
verses.8: We have turned against you, we have turned away from your light.
verses.9: For all of our days, we have turned aside from your path. All of us, in our years, have behaved like fools.
verses.10: In our years, there are seventy years. And in their reigns, it’s even more than that. Their days were filled with toil and suffering. For they became old quickly, and their time came to an end.
verses.11: Who knows what you’re capable of, and what your strength lies in?
verses.12: In order to live our days in this way, we must know and understand this wisdom.
verses.13: May the LORD come back to you until death, and may He comfort your servants.
verses.14: Let us praise your kindness this morning, and let us rejoice in every moment of our lives.
verses.15: Let us rejoice, for we have endured hardships. We have seen evil happen.
verses.16: I will see your deeds among your servants, and how you conduct yourself towards them.
verses.17: And may the kindness of our God be upon us, and may His actions be a blessing to us. May His actions be a source of strength for us.
